verdict.rationale: Adyen documents subscribable Transfer, Payment method and Dispute webhooks for Issuing. Payment-event webhooks notify you when a merchant initiates a payment and when funds are added to or deducted from balance accounts, so post-auth money movement is delivered programmatically alongside relayed authorisation webhooks. However, the evidence never names clearings, refunds or reversals as distinct event types, and never shows identifiers linking these events back to the original authorisation. missing for 10: explicit clearing/refund/reversal event types, documented stable transaction identifiers linking auth to post-auth events, chargeback outcome webhook detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of ledger reconciliation.
